title: Evaluation of the Competency of Large Language Models GPT-4o and Claude 3.5 Sonnet in Endodontic Emergencies

live_model.evidence: "Each LLM was used (GPT-4o available at: https://chatgpt.com/; Claude...)"; "81 open-ended questions were evaluated."

prompt.note: Each question was submitted directly as the prompt via the ChatGPT web app.

claim.metric: accuracy Likert score (1-5) on endodontic emergency questions

data.source: 81 open-ended endodontics questions, listed in Table 1

notes: GPT-4o was accessed through the ChatGPT consumer website, not the API, and is undated with no stated access date before 2024-10-02 (paper is 2025), so it cannot be pinned to gpt-4o-2024-05-13. "GPT-4 Turbo" appears only in a generic historical-background sentence (role C).
